paras.en: “What do you do here?” said the little prince.
“I sort the travellers into bundles of a thousand,” said the switchman. “I send off the trains that carry them away, sometimes to the right, sometimes to the left.”
paras.zh: “我把旅客分成一包一包，每包一千人。”扳道工说，“我把载着他们的火车发出去，一会儿向右，一会儿向左。”

paras.en: And a brightly lit express train, rumbling like thunder, shook the signal box.
paras.zh: 这时，一列灯火通明的快车发出雷鸣般的轰隆声，震得扳道房直颤。

paras.en: “They are in such a hurry,” said the little prince. “What are they looking for?”
paras.zh: “他们可真着急。”小王子说，“他们在找什么？”

paras.en: “Even the man in the engine doesn't know,” said the switchman.
paras.zh: “连车头里那个人自己也不知道。”扳道工说。

paras.en: And a second brightly lit express train rumbled past in the opposite direction.
paras.zh: 接着，第二列灯火通明的快车朝相反的方向轰隆驶过。

paras.en: “Are they coming back already?” asked the little prince…
paras.zh: “他们这么快就回来了？”小王子问……

paras.en: “They aren't the same people,” said the switchman. “It's an exchange.”
paras.zh: “不是同一批人。”扳道工说，“这是互相交换。”
“他们在原来待的地方不满意吗？”

paras.en: “We’re never happy where we are,” said the switchman.
paras.zh: “人总是不满意自己所在的地方，”扳道工说。

paras.en: And a third brightly lit express train sent out a rumble of thunder.
paras.zh: 接着，第三列灯火通明的快车发出了雷鸣般的轰响。

paras.en: “Are they chasing the first travellers?” asked the little prince.
paras.zh: “他们在追赶最先那批旅客吗？”小王子问。

paras.en: “They’re not chasing anything at all,” said the switchman. “They sleep in there, or else they yawn. Only the children press their noses flat against the windows.”
paras.zh: “他们什么也没在追赶，”扳道工说，“他们在车里睡觉，或者打哈欠。只有孩子们把鼻子贴在车窗玻璃上，压得扁扁的。”

paras.en: “Only the children know what they’re looking for,” said the little prince. “They waste time on a rag doll, and it becomes very important, and if someone takes it away from them, they cry…”
paras.zh: “只有孩子们知道自己在寻找什么，”小王子说，“他们为一个碎布娃娃耗费时间，而它变得非常重要，而要是有人把它从他们手里拿走，他们就哭……”
